title: Product Cross-Reference Card: Kestrel Care Plan Points on a Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Unpaid Installment Charge
content:
**Product cross-reference card — Kestrel Care Vehicle Service Contract holders with a Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract.**

**Rule.** When the customer holds an active Kestrel Care plan financed in this contract, 0.5 percentage points are taken off the unpaid installment rate; when the customer holds an active Kestrel Care plan financed some other way, 0.25 points are taken off; in every other case no points are taken off.

A Kestrel Care plan is a Kestrel Care Vehicle Service Contract of the same customer. It is financed in this contract when the Care contract's record shows this retail contract's account number as the account it is financed in; an active Care plan whose record shows no financing account, or another account, is financed some other way. Only a Care plan in active status counts.

The points come off the unpaid installment rate that applies to the contract, which is then applied once to the unpaid installment portion.

| Customer's Kestrel Care Vehicle Service Contract | Points taken off |
|---|---|
| active, financed in this retail contract | 0.5 |
| active, financed some other way | 0.25 |
| no Care plan in active status | 0 |

*Hypothetical:* a customer holds an active Care plan financed in a Kestrel lease and no other Care plan; it is financed some other way, so 0.25 points come off. A customer holding two active Care plans, one of them financed in this contract, takes 0.5 points off.
